intro: Lord Baurles K. Wishock is a nobleman residing in Stormwind Keep's Petitioner's Chamber. Known among barkeeps for his unpaid tabs and fondness for strong drink, he stumbled upon darker dealings than mere drunkenness in the city's underbelly.

p: Holding court among the petitioners and dignitaries within Stormwind Keep, Lord Baurles K. Wishock is a member of the influential House of Nobles. Despite his elevated station, Wishock developed a habit of frequenting the dive bars of the Mage Quarter, especially the Slaughtered Lamb, leaving behind substantial unpaid bills. While drinking there, however, he caught wind of the warlock coven practicing dark arts in the cellars beneath the floorboards. Determined to shut the tavern down, Wishock began petitioning fellow nobles for a formal investigation—unaware that uncovering demonic cabals in Stormwind rarely goes unpunished.
